title: All Goals in the Men's World Cup
subtitle: 92 years, one trophy-shaped canvas
description: A striking data-art visualisation of every goal ever scored in the Men's World Cup from 1930–2022, using the iconic trophy as its canvas.

title: “Brilliant. In every way.” Are they really?
subtitle: 5,010 iPhone XR reviews, dissected
description: A deep dive into 5,010 Amazon reviews of the iPhone XR, analysing star ratings, sentiment, helpfulness behaviour, and temporal trends against Apple's own marketing claim.

title: Colombo's Temperature in Colour
subtitle: A year of climate, as heat-stripes
description: A colour-driven portrait of Colombo's 2024 climate, mapping every day's high and low as vertical heat-stripes — warm oranges against cool violets.

title: COVID-19 Insights
subtitle: Global-to-country pandemic tracking
description: An interactive analytics app offering global, regional, and country-level insight into COVID-19 trends, testing effectiveness, and case dynamics with real-time visualisation.

title: Cristiano in the Big Five
subtitle: One icon, five leagues
description: A sweeping, narrative-driven visual exploring Cristiano Ronaldo's journey across Europe's Big Five leagues, blending storytelling, club symbolism, and trophy data.

title: Die Gegenpress
subtitle: Every Liverpool goal under Klopp
description: A comprehensive, interactive visual archive of every goal scored by Liverpool under Jürgen Klopp — scorers, opponents, venues, and minute-by-minute patterns.

title: Echoes of Earth
subtitle: Every M7.0+ quake, 2000–2025
description: A global map of every magnitude 7.0+ earthquake from 2000–2025, plotted against coastlines and tectonic boundaries.

title: Elite Footballers, Team of the Season
subtitle: ML-selected squads vs. FIFA TOTS
description: Data-driven models that evaluate player performance across Europe's top five leagues to generate objective Team of the Season squads, outperforming human-selected FIFA TOTS lineups in a majority of seasons.

title: Email Communication Analysis
subtitle: Organisational communication dashboard
description: A multi-layer analytical dashboard exploring emails across a company's departments: time-based patterns, sentiment, topics, departmental flows, and employee-level networks.

title: EuroPharm Analytics
subtitle: Decision-intelligence dashboard
description: A decision-intelligence dashboard transforming pharmacy sales data into strategic insight, integrating benchmarking, portfolio analytics, and simulation to drive profit-focused decisions.

title: Happy Little Colours
subtitle: 31 seasons of Bob Ross, as Voronoi art
description: A season-by-season visual exploration of Bob Ross's iconic painting palette, transforming his most-used hues into a Voronoi art piece across 31 seasons of The Joy of Painting.

title: Le Roi
subtitle: Pelé's 1,284 goals, one grid
description: A minimalist tribute to Pelé's historic 1,284-goal career, using a dense gold-toned grid where every square marks a match.

title: Nova Credit Risk Lab
subtitle: XGBoost-driven credit risk system
description: A credit risk analytics system built around an XGBoost model and a custom profit proxy, with policy simulation tooling and an ethics-by-design approach that excludes sensitive features.

title: Pola
subtitle: A Virtual Market of AI Shopkeepers
description: A 3D open-air market where seven AI shopkeepers, each with a distinct personality, hold live agentic conversations and run real commerce actions against Kapruka's product catalog.

title: Studio Ghibli — Budget vs. Revenue
subtitle: 40 years, one scatterplot
description: Exploring 40 years of Studio Ghibli films through an interactive budget-versus-revenue scatterplot, with rich tooltips, film stills, and a break-even reference.

title: The Tragic Times
subtitle: The Titanic, as a 1912 newspaper
description: A historically styled analytical report exploring how class, age, gender, and fare influenced survival among 418 Titanic passengers — visualised as a period newspaper front page.

title: The Wonderful World of Pokémon
subtitle: Types, stats, and optimal teams
description: A comprehensive analysis of Pokémon types, stats, and battle dynamics, paired with interactive visuals, to uncover patterns and build optimal teams.

title: Tidying the Tides
subtitle: 19M-item ocean cleanup study
description: A comprehensive visual exploration of ocean cleanup efforts across the US: locations, trash volume, item types, seasonal patterns, and correlations across 19 million collected items.

title: Transferium Player Intelligence
subtitle: Graph-powered replacement finder
description: A graph database-powered football player replacement finder built on Neo4j, Python, and Streamlit — searching 18,405 FC 26 players with a weighted cosine similarity engine.

title: Voltage Verdicts
subtitle: Electronics review intelligence
description: An analytical dashboard built from online electronics reviews across seven major retailers, exploring rating patterns, brand and category trends, and inter-brand networks.

title: Washington's Woes
subtitle: Investigative crime-pattern narrative
description: A newsroom-style deep dive into Washington D.C. crime patterns, blending geospatial mapping, temporal analysis, and UCR classifications into a single investigative visual narrative.
